responsibility: This definition module declares the direct C libm bindings used by the GNU Modula-2 runtime. It belongs to the low-level numeric interop layer and exports elementary functions for REAL, SHORTREAL, and LONGREAL precision—including trigonometric, exponential, logarithmic, power, square-root, floor, and ceil operations—serving primarily as the callable backend for higher-level math modules such as MathLib0, LMathLib0, and SMathLib0 when compiler inline builtins are not used.
